title: Upgrade your PHP installs immediately to protect against php2shell
content:
This morning, two critical PHP Security Advisories were published:

  • RCE via OOM corruption (9.2/10)
  • RCE via stale global state (9.2/10)

If you're running PHP for any service, you need to upgrade immediately to 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27, or 8.5.12. And if you use Remi's repos on RedHat-derivative Linux distros, you need to switch to official repos temporarily as Remi's on vacation and can't update his community repo. (Reminds me of xkcd 2347). Remi pushed updates even while on vacation!
